_comment: Keep in sync with the Customizable dataConnectorDefinitions resource in azuredeploy.json (used by the standalone Deploy to Azure button / connector self-deployment instruction step). This file exists solely so the connector tile is discovered by the solution packaging tool via Data/Solution_RecordedFuture.json's "Data Connectors" list.
title: Recorded Future - Log Ingestion
descriptionMarkdown: Imports Recorded Future data into Microsoft Sentinel via the Log Ingestion API. Writes playbook alerts to `RecordedFuturePlaybookAlerts_V2_CL`, classic alerts to `RecordedFutureClassicAlerts_V2_CL`, threat map data to `RecordedFutureThreatMap_V2_CL` and `RecordedFutureThreatMapMalware_V2_CL`, and sandbox results to `RecordedFutureSandboxResults_V2_CL`.

dataTypes.name: RecordedFuturePlaybookAlerts_V2_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
RecordedFuturePlaybookAlerts_V2_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

dataTypes.name: RecordedFutureClassicAlerts_V2_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
RecordedFutureClassicAlerts_V2_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

dataTypes.name: RecordedFutureThreatMap_V2_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
RecordedFutureThreatMap_V2_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

dataTypes.name: RecordedFutureThreatMapMalware_V2_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
RecordedFutureThreatMapMalware_V2_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

dataTypes.name: RecordedFutureSandboxResults_V2_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
RecordedFutureSandboxResults_V2_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

value:
RecordedFuturePlaybookAlerts_V2_CL
| summarize LastLog = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLog >= ago(24h)

RecordedFutureClassicAlerts_V2_CL
| summarize LastLog = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLog >= ago(24h)

RecordedFutureThreatMap_V2_CL
| summarize LastLog = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLog >= ago(24h)

RecordedFutureThreatMapMalware_V2_CL
| summarize LastLog = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLog >= ago(24h)

RecordedFutureSandboxResults_V2_CL
| summarize LastLog = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLog >= ago(24h)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and write permissions are required.

customs.name: Azure Subscription
customs.description: Monitoring Contributor and Log Analytics Contributor permissions required to deploy the Data Connectors infrastructure. Owner or Role Based Access Control Administrator required to deploy playbooks with automatic role assignment.

customs.name: Recorded Future API Token
customs.description: A Recorded Future API token is required to authorize the Recorded Future Custom Connector used by the playbooks.

instructionSteps.title: Step 1 — Deploy Data Connectors infrastructure
instructionSteps.description:
Deploys the shared Data Collection Endpoint (DCE), Data Collection Rules (DCRs), Log Analytics tables, and this connector definition tile. Deploy this into the same resource group as your Log Analytics Workspace.

[![Deploy to Azure](https://aka.ms/deploytoazurebutton)](https://portal.azure.com/#create/Microsoft.Template/uri/https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FAzure%2FAzure-Sentinel%2Fmaster%2FSolutions%2FRecorded%20Future%2FData%20Connectors%2Fazuredeploy.json)

instructionSteps.title: Step 2 — Deploy the Recorded Future Custom Connector
instructionSteps.description:
The custom connector handles authentication towards the Recorded Future API. Deploy it once — it is shared by the playbooks.

[![Deploy to Azure](https://aka.ms/deploytoazurebutton)](https://portal.azure.com/#create/Microsoft.Template/uri/https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FAzure%2FAzure-Sentinel%2Fmaster%2FSolutions%2FRecorded%20Future%2FPlaybooks%2FConnectors%2FRecordedFuture-CustomConnector%2Fazuredeploy.json)

instructionSteps.title: Step 3 — Deploy playbooks
instructionSteps.description: Deploy one or more playbooks depending on your use case. No manual configuration is needed — each playbook connects to the Data Connectors infrastructure deployed in Step 1 automatically.
